newsitem.title: UK: UK Treasury says inflation under firm control.
newsitem.headline: UK Treasury says inflation under firm control.

text.p: Angela Knight, economic secretary to Britain's Treasury, said after the release of January retail price figures that inflation remained under firm control.
"Serious commentators, including the Bank of England in their Inflation Report yesterday, expect inflation to fall back over the coming months," she said in a statement.
"The strength of sterling and this week's excellent producer price figures show inflation remains under firm control."
Retail prices rose 2.8 percent y/y versus 2.5 percent in December while underlying annual inflation, RPIX, was unchanged at 3.1 percent.
